newsitem.title: UK: Slough drops as BZW cuts to "sell".
newsitem.headline: Slough drops as BZW cuts to "sell".

text.p: Shares in Slough Estates Plc fell on Wednesday as BZW cut the stock to "sell" from "hold" and warned that yesterday's rights issue by Great Portland Estates Plc could herald other cash calls, dealers said.
Slough shares were down 4p at 273-1/2 by 1344 GMT and other leading UK real estate stocks were also lower, with British Land down 7p at 498-1/2 and Land Securities Plc down 7p at 752-1/2.
Dealers said BZW repeated a "sell" rating on British Land but retained an "overweight" position on the sector as a whole, as prospects for sustainable growth looked strong.
Analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this week Land Securities said it was raising 210 million stg through a convertible bond issue.
